Read feature names

Source: R/index_input_geometry.R, R/vapour_input_attributes.R
vapour_read_fids.Rd

Obtains the internal 'Feature ID (FID)' for a data source.

Usage

vapour_read_fids_ia(
  dsource,
  layer = 0L,
  sql = "",
  extent = NA,
  ia = NULL,
  open_options = NULL
)

vapour_read_fids_ij(
  dsource,
  layer = 0L,
  sql = "",
  extent = NA,
  ij = NULL,
  open_options = NULL
)

vapour_read_fids(
  dsource,
  layer = 0L,
  sql = "",
  limit_n = NULL,
  skip_n = 0,
  extent = NA,
  open_options = NULL
)

vapour_read_names(
  dsource,
  layer = 0L,
  sql = "",
  limit_n = NULL,
  skip_n = 0,
  extent = NA,
  open_options = NULL
)

Arguments

dsource

data source name (path to file, connection string, URL)

layer

integer of layer to work with, defaults to the first (0) or the name of the layer

sql

if not empty this is executed against the data source (layer will be ignored)

extent

apply an arbitrary extent, only when 'sql' used (must be 'ex = c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)' but sp bbox, sf bbox, and raster extent also accepted)

ia

an arbitrary index, integer vector with values between 0 and one less the number of features, duplicates allowed and arbitrary order is ok

open_options

open options for the driver, a character vector of "NAME=VALUE" strings (as -oo in the GDAL command line tools), NULL for none. The options a driver accepts are listed on its page at https://gdal.org/en/stable/drivers/vector/index.html

ij

a range index, integer vector of length two with values between 0 and one less the number of features, this range of geometries is returned

limit_n

an arbitrary limit to the number of features scanned

skip_n

an arbitrary number of features to skip

Value

numeric vector of feature ids

Details

This may be virtual (created by GDAL for the SQL interface) and may be 0- or 1- based. Some drivers have actual names, and they are persistent and arbitrary. Please use with caution, this function can return the current FIDs, but there's no guarantee of what it represents for subsequent access.

An earlier version used 'OGRSQL' to obtain these names, which was slow for some drivers and also clashed with independent use of the sql argument.

vapour_read_names() is an older name, aliased to vapour_read_fids().

vapour_read_fids_ia gives the feature ids at chosen positions (ia, counted from 0, in any order and with repeats) and vapour_read_fids_ij those in an inclusive range of positions (ij). A position that is not in the layer gives NA, with a warning. These turn positions into the values that the fa argument of vapour_read_geometry_fa() and vapour_read_fields_fa() takes.

Examples

file <- "list_locality_postcode_meander_valley.tab"
mvfile <- system.file(file.path("extdata/tab", file), package="vapour")
range(fids <- vapour_read_names(mvfile))
#> [1]  1 58
length(fids)
#> [1] 58
vapour_read_fids_ia(mvfile, ia = c(0, 5, 2))
#> [1] 1 6 3
vapour_read_fids_ij(mvfile, ij = c(0, 2))
#> [1] 1 2 3
